# Financieele Dagblad highlights Burford Capital in article about WAMCA claims in the Netherlands


May 19, 2025


-
-
-
-


*Financieele Dagblad* reports on five years of WAMCA (the Collective Damages in Class Actions Act) claims in the Netherlands.


Burford is quoted: " *Within the WAMCA landscape some 75% of cases are now idealistic where no damages are claimed at all. We see that this landscape is shifting to more commercial high-value claims* ."


[The article is published in Dutch and can be read here.](https://fd.nl/politiek/1556390/nieuwe-massaclaimwet-levert-weinig-op-nog-geen-euro-uitgekeerd)
